title: The Cutting Edge: Week of August 23rd
body:
**Highlights**
- Introducing the ‘[EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/dev-digest-week-of-aug-22/)’, a new periodic developer-oriented newsletter release for technical contributions and achieved milestones.
- Commonwealth Labs brought massive functionality upgrades to [the Keygen page](https://edgewa.re/keygen). Users now can seamlessly transfer $EDG between the native WASM and EVM environments using Polkadot JS extension and Metamask (or any web3 evm extension).
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [latest release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.3.3) to proceed further with the ERUP-4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Webb Protocol’s [Docs website](https://docs.webb.tools/) is now live.
- Community members who are interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members who are interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
- Common Protocol partners with [ChainX](https://twitter.com/hicommonwealth/status/1430635427908759562?s=20).


**Governance**
- No active referendum. Upcoming: [ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1100-erup-4-substrate-30-evm-updates-runtime-modules)


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in, [take a look](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal).
- Recent/trending Community Research thread(s):
- [A glance at what's to come for development on Edgeware](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1577-a-glance-at-whats-to-come-for-development-on-edgeware/)
